name.ja: 回転ハイブリッド・リーマンソルバー

summary.ja: 速度差に合わせた方向と直交方向で散逸を組む回転ハイブリッド法。Ren（2003）、西川–北村（2008）、Roe・西川ら（2005）の関連研究を区別し、公開HLLE/Roe実験の範囲を明示します。
summary.en: Construct directional dissipation using a velocity-jump frame. Distinguish Ren (2003), Nishikawa–Kitamura (2008) and related Roe–Nishikawa et al. (2005) research, and state the scope of the published HLLE/Roe experiment.

code_mapping_scope: Educational directional HLLE/Roe construction; not the optimized Rotated-RHLL dissipation formula in Nishikawa–Kitamura (2008). Other chapter flux modules are separate methods.
